notes: Your photo showed more working than it looked. All 16 parking sensors were rendering, which only happens when 16 live values arrive - they were correctly showing 'nothing detected' in an empty yard, but as dim grey pills with no words, which is indistinguishable from a dead feature. Speed, battery and lights were live too. The fault was the design, not the data. Fixed: the sensors now say ALL CLEAR in green when they are reporting and nothing is near, STOP or CLOSE in red and amber when something is, and NO SENSOR DATA only when the van truly sends nothing - so you can tell at a glance which of those three it is. The segments are much thicker and the van is bigger. The speed readout and steering dial now size themselves from the card instead of fixed dp, so a tiny 0 no longer floats in an acre of grey on a 13 inch panel - speed scales up to roughly three times its old size. Steering is now a proper arc dial with a needle sweeping from centre rather than a flat line that looked identical whether working or not. Turn the wheel while parked and it moves - that is the fastest proof the CAN link is alive, since steering is the only live reading on this van that works with the engine off. Headlights are two lamps at the nose instead of the stray beige bar floating above the van.
